questions.prompt: Who declared a state of emergency on Guam before the typhoon hit?
questions.hintKo: It was Guam's governor, not the president, NWS, JTWC, or military.

questions.prompt: What category was Super Typhoon Bavi when it made landfall on Monday?
questions.hintKo: At 180 mph, Bavi was the highest category possible — Category 5.

questions.prompt: Where did the eye of Typhoon Bavi pass directly over?
questions.hintKo: Rota, in the Northern Mariana Islands, took the direct hit from Bavi's eye.

questions.prompt: When did Guam's governor say she would begin damage assessments?
questions.hintKo: She specifically said 'first thing tomorrow morning' — Tuesday morning.

questions.prompt: Why were shelters on Saipan and Tinian already full when Bavi approached?
choices: The government ordered everyone to go
Many residents still had no power from Typhoon Sinlaku in April
questions.hintKo: The previous typhoon (Sinlaku) left many without power, making them more vulnerable and shelters were packed.

questions.prompt: How fast were the maximum sustained winds of Super Typhoon Bavi?
questions.hintKo: 180 mph is correct — equivalent to 290 kilometers per hour.
